developer_response.body:
Our modler designed the model to be funny and not meant to be taken seriously.

If you’re playing on Quest 2, you may experience some sticky movement—this is a known issue, and we’re working on a fix for the next update.

Please try the game again once the update is released!

Thanks for your feedback. We'd really appreciate it if you could elaborate on what went wrong so we can improve the game. If you're willing, please join our Discord server and let us know what issues you experienced, whether they were bugs, performance problems, or gameplay concerns. We actively listen to community feedback and are constantly working on updates and fixes.

Discord: https://discord.gg/HepySFApNf

We hope you'll give the game another try after future updates.
